documents: Thapoth Corp is led by its chief executive, Kouprith Taediak. The head of Batrom Labs is Doufith Droudon. Update, this has changed: 1990 is the year Niasham Bruthour was born. Munaeth Drukiar resides in Prathiakron. Thapoth Corp employs Biglaer Mouglun.
Tiaton Shadir was born in 1967. Batrom Labs is headquartered in Zouglesax. Thapoth Corp is best known for Liabaex-38. The flagship product of Batrom Labs is Zhoutrom-15.
Tiaton Shadir lives in Brufobrun. Munaeth Drukiar works as a harbor pilot. Poprak Labs employs Tiaton Shadir.

Doufith Droudon is on the staff of Batrom Labs. Brufobrun is the home city of Biglaer Mouglun. Tiaton Shadir's occupation is salt trader. Batrom Labs began operating in 1973. Prathiakron is the home city of Doufith Droudon.
Doufith Droudon works as a tea taster. Biglaer Mouglun works as a weaver. Update, this has changed: 1984 is the year Glopaeth Ruzhax was born. Munaeth Drukiar came into the world in 1976.

Munaeth Drukiar works at Mabak Corp. Update, this has changed: The flagship product of Poprak Labs is Fashim-92. Thapoth Corp was founded in 1949. Update, this has changed: Niasham Bruthour is on the staff of Poprak Labs.
Update, this has changed: By trade, Kouprith Taediak is a clock repairer. The headquarters of Thapoth Corp are in Duliprur. Biglaer Mouglun came into the world in 1993.
